Aj (Sales): FYI handing off VerdantAI — signed for Dedicated capacity (3x A100 reserved), expected go-live in ~6 weeks. Need SSO/SAML, PII scoping, and a custom DB connector. Budget hold may affect renewal in Q4 :thinking_face:
Devon (CSM): Thanks Aj. Quick context please — what level of PII are they planning to store? and who's the main contact?
Aj (Sales): Main contact: emma@verdantai.com (CTO). They plan to store customer support transcripts + hashed user IDs. No raw SSNs but some health-related flags. Sales did security questionnaire but SSO details pending.
Devon (CSM): Ok. I'll own onboarding. Tagging Lina for support intake and Rahul for connector feasibility. @Lina @Rahul
Lina (Support): Got it. I'll open a support intake ticket for SSO and a runbook for Dedicated env. Any preferred SAML IdP?
Aj (Sales): They use Okta. Have a sample metadata file from them.
Rahul (Eng): Connector — what DB? PostgreSQL behind a VPN? Or cloud-hosted?
Aj (Sales): It's self-hosted Postgres in their VPC. They want us to pull nightly dumps via a secure tunnel.
Devon (CSM): Risk notes: budget sign-off still pending; they asked for a 6-month discount to hit numbers. I'll mark renewal risk = medium-high and loop Maria.
Maria (CS Manager): @Devon please add a short risk plan. If this goes sideways we want runway: 1) confirm SSO + PII acceptance 2) milestone-based billing 3) executive sponsor alignment.
Devon (CSM): Drafting next steps below and will add to the account in Gainsight.
Devon (CSM): NEXT STEPS (owners):
- Devon: schedule kickoff meeting with VerdantAI + internal kickoff (by 1765432160)
- Lina: open support ticket with labels [verdantai,dedicated,sso] and attach Okta metadata (by 1765432200)
- Rahul: scope connector feasibility & security pattern (SSH tunnel vs. direct peering) and estimate effort (by 1765432300)
- Maria: approve risk mitigation plan & decide on exec sponsor (by 1765432350)
- Aj: share contract addendum request (discount ask) with finance (done)
Lina (Support): Support intake created: ticket #SUP-8421. Placeholder runbook added.
OnboardBot: Reminder: kickoff meeting not scheduled. Use /schedule-kickoff VerdantAI to propose times.
Rahul (Eng): Quick note on connector: Prefer to avoid long-lived DB creds. Propose SFTP nightly export + verification. If they insist on live queries we'll need a bastion + least-priv role. Estimated 2 dev-weeks for initial MVP.
Devon (CSM): Good. Lina — please also request their security contact and SOC2 evidence. Put items in SUP-8421.
Lina (Support): Added request for security contact + latest SOC2 + contact for network engineering.
Aj (Sales): Emma is looping their infra lead: marc@verdantai.com.
Devon (CSM): I'll send calendar invites once Aj confirms available times. Also prepping an enablement doc for their team: topics = API keys, model routing, cost controls, and dedicated quotas.
Maria (CS Manager): If this becomes a critical renewal, we escalate to Sales leadership and offer a milestone SLA review.
Rahul (Eng): One technical ask: will they want model custom weights or just standard open models? Impacts infra.
Aj (Sales): Initially standard models, may request fine-tuning later.
Devon (CSM): Action item for engineering later — plan for fine-tune path but not required for immediate onboarding.
Devon (CSM): I'll capture all of this in the customer record and set a 2-week check-in cadence.
Aj (Sales): Thanks team. Please ping if you need anything from me. :thumbsup:
Lina (Support): ACK. SUP-8421 will track SSO/PII/soc2.
Rahul (Eng): ACK — will post feasibility notes in the ticket by 1765432300.
Maria (CS Manager): I'll review the risk plan by 1765432350 and reply with sponsor suggestion.
Devon (CSM): Closing the loop — kickoff invite sent. Meeting notes to follow.
(Reaction): :eyes: on the plan from all.
